$comment: Approved title, meta description and H1 changes for the parity gate (scripts/seo/parity.mjs reads this file). Each value is the exact new text; any other change to a title, meta or H1 is still an error. Source: the verified titles-meta review of 2026-10-17 (70 changes on 42 pages: 60 accepted, 4 amended, 6 added by the verifier; the DIY meta was rejected and is not here), with "380+" read as "560+" in the four metas that state the Google review count (decision D7: the Mesa profile shows 567 reviews on 2026-10-17). The values ship through the content pipeline (migration/content-data/titles-meta.json, scripts/migrate/content/titles-meta.mjs), which checks that every value it sets equals the one here. notDeployed lists the approved changes held back on purpose: the gate reports them as pending, and as an error if one ships early. frozenTitleAndH1: the 13 Tier 1 pages, whose title and H1 can never be approved for a change. Empty changes after the post-launch re-baseline. removed: live pages taken off the site on purpose (decision D15, 2026-10-19: the generator posts), each with the page it now 301s to in one hop; the gate reports the redirect as approved, and as an error if the page still answers 200, redirects elsewhere or chains. The content pipeline (migration/content-data/removed-posts.json) checks that it holds the same paths and redirects. A Tier 1 page can never be removed. added: pages new to the site on purpose (decision D18, 2026-10-19: three service pages), each with its exact title, meta description and H1; the gate fails if one is missing, answers anything but 200, is noindexed, has another canonical or shows another value, or if an added path is already live in the baseline. The content pipeline (migration/content-data/titles-meta.json rows with `added`) checks that it holds the same values.
